constraint_decided_it: Nothing in domain/range or FOL separated the core modelling: both apply P124 (E81 -> E18) and P123 (E81 -> E18) to E22, a subclass of E19/E24 and hence of E18, so both hold. Both miss the same constraint: P14 carried out by is declared E7 -> E39 and E81 is a subclass of E63/E64 only, not of E7, so neither answer can attach the named seamstress; the CRM's own P123 and E12 examples fix this by multiply instantiating the event as (E81, E12).
better_modelling: One event instantiated as both E81 Transformation and E12 Production: P124 transformed the wedding gown (E22), P123 resulted in the christening gown (E22) AND P108 has produced the christening gown (E24/E22), P14 carried out by the seamstress (E21), P4 has time-span (1950s). This is verbatim the pattern of the CRM's own examples -- 'The transformation of the Venetian Loggia in Heraklion into a city hall (E81, E12) resulted in the City Hall of Heraklion (E24). [AND: has produced (P108) ...]' and 'Rembrandt's creating of the seventh state of his etching ... (E12, E65, E81)'. E12 is required because the result is declared E22 ('purposely created by human activity') and because E12's own scope note carries the identical E81 carve-out, adding 'matter is preserved, but identity is not'. Neither answer proposes E12/P108/P14, so both leave the maker and the intentional-production side of a cataloguing question unrecordable.
reasoning: Both correctly reject bare E11/P31 on the strength of E11's scope-note redirect, whose wording ('In this case, the new items have separate identities') I verified verbatim at crm732#E11, and both stay inside P123/P124's declared E81 -> E18 range. Both are suboptimal for the same reason: they treat E81 as exclusive of E11's branch when the CRM's worked examples require the conjunction (E81, E12), without which P14 carried out by cannot be applied to the event at all and P108 has produced is lost. B edges ahead because its extra discriminations are real constraint checks that all verify -- E81's exclusion of E17 Type Assignment is verbatim in its scope note, issue287#outcome literally states 'E81 Transformation is certainly better than E11 Modification because the matrix has a distinct identity both before and after the change', and issue12#current-s0000 contains both 'a piece of money becoming a piece of jewelry' and 'preserves some recognizable identity' -- whereas A adds only P92/P93, which are merely the superproperties already entailed by P123(x,y) => P92(x,y) and P124(x,y) => P93(x,y), and reports its (in fact accurate) E11 quotation as unverified.
